description: This file defines a singleton object AuthStore in Kotlin that acts as an in-memory store for an authentication token (bearer token) during the app session. It provides methods to set and get the token, serving as a simple placeholder for real auth storage.

classes.name: AuthStore
classes.description: A singleton object functioning as an in-memory store for the bearer token during the current app session.

methods.name: setBearerToken
methods.description: Sets the bearer token for the current process/session.

methods.name: getBearerToken
methods.description: Retrieves the bearer token for the current process/session.
